title: Tower Maze Defense (v47)
description: Enhanced tower defense with projectile pass-through, upgrade-all buttons, and rich maze generation.
prompt: With the new weapon upgrades (l4 and l5), it is now too easy. stagger in new levels - dont introduce l4 upgrades until wave 65. introduce l5 at a suitable wave. move the stars of upgraded weapons to be on the same tile as the weapon - currently the stars are 1 tile above which can make it seem like the stars belong to the weapon above - fix. change the cycle speed (1x 2x 3x 5x 10x 15x 20x) button to 2 buttons - and up arrow and a down arrow to increase/decrease speed. make these buttons half-width so both take up a normal button space (dont make button 100% height so you can fit in title/desc)
